events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Don't mention the war', his genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968, marking 58 years since its debut.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sounds revolutionary today.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – forever etched in rock history. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, making this its 61st anniversary.

angles.name: Revolutionary Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving artistry and songwriting depth.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years after we lost him. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. An innovator, an icon, and forever a starman.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His music still moves the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! Still rocking and captivating audiences worldwide.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of the iconic British band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still driving us all 'One Step Beyond'.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a generation and still sound incredible.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon whose talent and generosity shine brighter than her rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer, songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Cheers to the man behind so many classic hits.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our playlists today.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, making this its 41st anniversary.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: Forty-one years since the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors for the very first induction. Who was in that first class? A who's who of legends!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still shining bright as part of Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on top of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969, marking 58 years since the iconic event.

angles.name: Iconic Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their final public performance. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary British singer, songwriter, and drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, a true music icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Superstar
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's still bringing 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, known for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: British TV Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television.

events.title: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash on February 3, 1959.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three music pioneers on 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend himself, Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up on our playlists.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The iconic Jamaican reggae musician Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Reggae King
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His music and message of unity live on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter Carole King, one of the most successful female songwriters of all time, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Songwriting Legend
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs have soundtracked generations and continue to resonate.
